description:
Observes the WHOLE subscription lifecycle in Stripe TEST mode: a test customer (card 4242…, a Checkbox inbox) subscribes; Checkbox waits for the acknowledgment, fast-forwards a test clock through each notice window (collecting reminders), cancels online and waits for the confirmation. Nothing is charged.
Needs the site's Stripe TEST restricted key (rk_test_…): store it with store_stripe_test_key; never ask the human to paste a key. Non-Stripe sites: type "generic". When the compliance plan asks for a run and the key is stored, Checkbox starts it automatically (test mode); this tool then returns that run.
Takes 1-2 minutes (real_checkout: a few): poll get_test_run with wait: 55. Each step reports observations, checks and fixes; apply them and run again.
mode "real_checkout" is the PROOF run: the shopper buys through the merchant's own checkout on its test deployment (stripe.checkout_url or stripe.payment_link), so the merchant's webhook handlers and email code fire; give stripe.test_account + stripe.cancel_url when customers cancel in the app. Several plan buttons: pass plan, or stripe.pre_checkout_steps [{action:"click",text:"<button>"}]. A step is "passed" only with evidence; "warning" means needs review.
Cancel: stripe.cancel_via "stripe_portal" (default) or "merchant_flow" (cancel_url + cancel_steps; behind a login, test_account { login_url, email, password }).

advance_time.description: Advance a Stripe test clock through trial end and first renewal (default true).

cancel.description: Cancel online at the end (default true).

checkout_steps.description: Shortcut for stripe.checkout_steps (embedded checkout: fill email/card, tick consent, click pay).

checkout_url.description: Shortcut for stripe.checkout_url (real_checkout: your checkout page on your TEST deployment).

email_wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for each email (default 120).

generic.description: Generic (non-Stripe) options as in the API: checkout_url, checkout_steps, complete_purchase { steps, promo_code }, account { login_url, email, password }, cancel_steps.

mode.description: Stripe runs: mirror (default; test clock through every notice window) or real_checkout (the proof run through the merchant's own checkout, webhooks and emails).

plan.description: Plan to run: a registered checkout config name or a price_… its line_items use.

region.description: State the synthetic shopper visits from, e.g. "US-CA".

site.description: Site id (site_…). Optional when the account has exactly one site in this mode; list_sites shows them.

cancel_steps.description: Clicks that cancel in your flow.

cancel_url.description: Cancel on your own page instead of the Stripe customer portal.

checkout_config.description: Registered checkout config (scc_…) to mirror; default the newest, else the latest live Checkout Session; "none" skips registered configs.

checkout_steps.description: real_checkout with an EMBEDDED checkout (Stripe Elements / Payment Element on your page): the steps that pay, e.g. [{"action":"fill","selector":"#email","value":"{{email}}"},{"action":"fill","selector":"#card","value":"4242424242424242"},{"action":"click","text":"I agree"},{"action":"click","text":"Pay"}]. {{email}} is the shopper's address (the run inbox).

checkout_url.description: real_checkout: your checkout page on your TEST deployment.

cleanup_url.description: Page that ends the test account's subscription before the checkout, so every run starts without one.

coupon.description: Mirror: TEST-mode coupon id for the test subscription.

payment_link.description: A Payment Link (plink_… or buy.stripe.com URL) to mirror or buy through.

pre_checkout_steps.description: real_checkout: clicks to reach the payment page, e.g. [{"action":"click","text":"Subscribe"}].

price.description: A TEST-mode price id (price_…) to subscribe to when nothing is registered.

price_map.description: Live price id → test-mode price id.

promotion_code.description: Mirror: TEST-mode promotion code (promo_… or code).

reset_url.description: Page that resets the test account before the checkout.

test_account.description: Test account on your deployment (password stored encrypted). email "{{inbox}}" signs up with the run's own test inbox.
Shortcut for stripe.test_account. email "{{inbox}}" uses the run inbox.

type.description: stripe (default when a Stripe test key is stored) or generic (test coupon / test account, no time travel).

name: start_test_run
title: Run a synthetic test subscription (test mode)
